## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation (Energy, Communication, Technology positive this week) and mixed leadership across cyclical Energy/Utilities while large-cap Tech shows internal divergence; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 concentrated in Technology & Communication).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +10.49%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +11.84%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +18.49%) ABOVE TREND. Communication strong: NFLX (1W: +27.72% | 1M: +16.75%) ABOVE TREND, TTWO (1W: +9.35% | 1M: -10.61%) RECOVERY. Technology showing pockets of strength: INTU (1W: +16.55% | 1M: -16.68%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?

Consumer Discretionary mixed/soft: LOW (1W: -6.27% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: +7.98% | 1M: -18.26%) RECOVERY. Materials showing mild weakness/rotation: PPG (1W: -4.91% | 1M: +2.90%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +27.72% | 1M: +16.75%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +16.55% | 1M: -16.68%) RECOVERY, CEG (1W: +11.35% | 1M: +13.81%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +11.16% | 1M: -4.41%) RECOVERY, TTWO (1W: +9.35% | 1M: -10.61%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 concentrated in Technology & Communication).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -11.07% | 1M: -12.76%) BELOW TREND, LOW (1W: -6.27% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -5.21%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND, TXN (1W: -4.57% | 1M: -4.18%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select high-multiple Tech and Consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: NFLX (1W: +27.72%), INTU (1W: +16.55%), PLTR (1W: +11.16%). Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: multiple large names show 1W up / 1M down (INTU, PLTR, NOW, CRM, MSFT) — this is actionable as tactical RECOVERY setups but suppresses single-factor regime calls; watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed, rotational. NVDA (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -5.21%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: +3.66% | 1M: -7.85%) RECOVERY, AAPL (1W: -0.55% | 1M: +2.59%) CORRECTION — sector breadth positive but 1M weakness persists; watch for confirmation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Cautious/neutral. V (1W: +4.56% | 1M: -3.20%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +5.03% | 1M: -4.18%) RECOVERY, JPM (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -2.89%) BELOW TREND — Financials are participating this week but 1M metrics remain soft; style: mixed / no clear leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive tone but mixed. JNJ (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +9.94%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +0.90%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: -3.83% | 1M: -0.44%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth positive with select names leading.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Neutral stance: favor trim exposure to names showing clear BELOW TREND (NVDA, EL, LRCX) and favor selectively positioned names showing ABOVE TREND and confirmed earnings/news (XOM, CVX, JNJ, NFLX). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; treat RECOVERY names as tactical opportunities, not core commitment.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +27.72% | 1M: +16.75%) ABOVE TREND — monitor for follow-through; VLO (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +18.49%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -5.21%) BELOW TREND — watch for further downside; EL (1W: -11.07% | 1M: -12.76%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.67% | 1M: +14.28%) — breadth strength. BEARISH: Consumer Staples (1W: -1.39% | 1M: +6.75%) — selective pressure from EL; watch Consumer Discretionary for geopolitics-driven volatility.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NFLX: monitor weekly follow-through above recent breakout high to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; NVDA: watch 1W support breach for confirmation of BELOW TREND; CVX: keep an eye on reaction to energy headlines — sustained >1M gains would reinforce ABOVE TREND.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PG (+75): headline on $10bn payout plan; price not in detailed list here — watch for confirmation. (Note: limited dual-timeframe data for some news names in provided dataset.) [Cross-ref limited by available time-series; prioritize verification in platform.]

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CVX (-45): Chevron Leviathan shutdown headline; CVX (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +11.84%) ABOVE TREND — negative news but price remains strong (divergence). UNH (-45): leadership/legal headline; UNH (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +0.90%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but price holding (divergence).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership given Tech divergence and Energy/Utilities participation. NFLX (1W: +27.72% | 1M: +16.75%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +10.49%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +9.94%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large-cap Tech (multiple RECOVERY names vs several BELOW TREND) and negative headlines for CVX/UNH are diverging from price — monitor for confirmation before shifting regime.
